certificates_revoked_has_reason.name: certificates_revoked_has_reason
certificates_revoked_has_reason.value: "certificates"."status" = 'active' or ("certificates"."revoked_reason" is not null and "certificates"."revoked_at" is not null)

coupons_value_matches_kind.name: coupons_value_matches_kind
coupons_value_matches_kind.value:
("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_off" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."amount_off_kobo" is null)
        or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."amount_off_kobo" > 0 and "coupons"."percent_off" is null)

threads_unanswered_idx.name: threads_unanswered_idx
threads_unanswered_idx.where: "threads"."kind" = 'question' and "threads"."answered_at" is null and "threads"."deleted_at" is null
